thread:
morgan: Follow-up from the billing postmortem: delayed consumer ack caused a replay window that inflated token counts for a subset of invoices. We need a compact remediation plan with clear owners, a timeline for credits, and signals to detect recurrence.

asha: I can lead credits + customer comms. Proposed approach: auto-apply credits under $40, flag >$400 for manual review. Will prepare a CSV template and sample email. Target Tue EOD (2026-03-31).

kai: i'll own detection & RC doc. Immediate steps: add idempotency header, tighten consumer ACK timeout, and emit a replay_event metric. ETA Mon (2026-03-30).

devin: ops will implement a defensive dedupe in the backfill job and add a hard-stop when backlog > 5M tokens. i'll open PR with tests. ETA Mon morning (2026-03-30).

ellie-fin: finance needs a reconciled list: invoice_id, account_id, billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_usd, reason_code. asha pls attach to MET ticket when ready.

billing-bot: Created MET-5812 "Replay-induced duplicate ledger writes: reconciliation + credits" assignees: asha,kai,devin due: 2026-04-06

morgan: Action items summary:
- asha: credits CSV + email template + attach to MET-5812 (ETA 2026-03-31)
- kai: RC doc + metrics + detection dashboard (ETA 2026-03-30)
- devin: dedupe + hard-stop PR + rollback plan (ETA 2026-03-30)
- ellie-fin: validate CSV and sign-off on credits (ETA 2026-03-31)

Please ack and paste MET-5812 when you start work. Keep customer-facing comms coordinated through asha/ellie-fin to avoid duplicate notices.

asha: ack. drafting CSV now, will include a small-sample export for review.

kai: ack. adding replay_event metric and a Datadog dashboard. will include alert if duplicate rate > 0.1%.

devin: ack. starting PR and adding a unit test that simulates consumer restart + replay.

ellie-fin: ack. will run reconciliation and flag any credits > $1k for manual sign-off.

morgan: one more ask: please note any recurring-pattern indicators (consumer restarts, increased reprovisioning, backlog surges) in the RC doc so we can tie to historical incidents. we'll review MET-5812 in Friday billing sync. :white_check_mark:
